##### Project general facts

The Corner is a contemporary residential development designed to deliver a balanced lifestyle through modern architecture and functional living spaces. The project offers a diverse collection of residences, including studios, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom duplexes. Clean architectural lines and thoughtfully planned layouts create a sense of openness and comfort, making each home both practical and refined for everyday living.

The development supports an active and convenient lifestyle with a selection of essential amenities. Residents can relax by the swimming pool or maintain their routine in the fully equipped gym, while the integration of smart technologies enhances the overall living experience. Every residence is fitted with a Smart Home system, allowing seamless control of lighting, climate, and security, adding both comfort and efficiency to daily life.

Interiors are designed with a focus on quality and modern functionality, complemented by carefully selected materials and finishes. Kitchens feature cabinetry by Scavolini and sanitaryware by Heimberg, ensuring both style and durability. Residences are offered unfurnished, providing flexibility for personalization, while the overall finishing reflects a clean, contemporary aesthetic enhanced by smart living solutions.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages. At the heart of Dubailand is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. 

The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubailand also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits. In addition to its entertainment and recreational offerings, Dubailand features a wide range of retail and dining options.
